g.text: Fast or far: the six link speeds

text.style: font-size: 11.88px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: LoRa has six speed settings, called spreading factors (SF7 to SF12). The remote picks one by itself and shows FAST or SLOW on screen.

g.text: Each step up roughly doubles the time on air. In return the

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: receiver can pick out a weaker signal, so the link gets through

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: at longer distances and past more obstacles.

text.style: font-size: 11.16px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e0f11
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: The handheld checks the signal on every check-in and moves

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: up or down a setting by itself. You can also fix one setting in

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066
font-size: 11.16px; font-family: 'Avenir Next Demi Bold'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e0f11
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: On this band each unit may transmit for 10% of any hour (360

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: seconds). The firmware counts every message, keeps count

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Avenir Next'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6066

g.text: across restarts, and refuses to go over.
